import openpyxl
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/56427/1_56427_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/56427_0_376ce525/1_56427_output.xlsx")

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)

sheet_name = "Taul1" if "Taul1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.sheetnames[0]
ws_values = wb_values[sheet_name]
ws = wb[sheet_name]

def is_one(v):
    """True when a cell value represents the runner marker 1."""
    if v is None:
        return False
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return False
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v) == 1.0
    if isinstance(v, str):
        s = v.strip()
        try:
            return float(s) == 1.0
        except ValueError:
            return s == "1"
    return False

# Target range H2:S28
target_min_row, target_max_row = 2, 28
target_min_col, target_max_col = 8, 19
max_items = target_max_col - target_min_col + 1

# Find every group start in the whole data area (header is row 1).
max_row = ws_values.max_row
start_rows = [r for r in range(2, max_row + 1) if is_one(ws_values.cell(r, 2).value)]

# Map each start row to the values from column G until just before the next start row.
groups = {}
for i, start in enumerate(start_rows):
    end = start_rows[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(start_rows) else max_row + 1
    groups[start] = [ws_values.cell(r, 7).value for r in range(start, end)]

# Fill only H2:S28. Start rows get their transposed column-G group; all other rows are blank.
for r in range(target_min_row, target_max_row + 1):
    vals = groups.get(r, [])
    for offset, c in enumerate(range(target_min_col, target_max_col + 1)):
        ws.cell(r, c).value = vals[offset] if offset < len(vals) else None

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved {output_path}")
